summary: Existing not-comparable reason holds. The only gene-level author result (PMC12037384 Supplementary Table 1, retrieved via the Europe PMC OA bundle) is 72 DESeq2 padj<0.1 genes for OS- versus SS-housed dnFGFR males. GEO deposits only raw counts, and no author dnFGFR-versus-control genotype result exists. The registered pooled genotype contrast has no same-contrast comparator, and the selected housing table has no registered track and cannot meet 90% relevant coverage.

manualReview.summary: POA source verified; pooled genotype effect relabeled exploratory
manualReview.note: The deposited coverage/count source is accessible, maps to the registered pooled dnFGFR-versus-control genotype effect, and was rehashed locally (SHA-256 d7b36bef...). The author instead analyzes opposite-sex versus same-sex housing separately within genotype. A naïve author-axis dnFGFR OS-minus-SS reproduction strongly matches the top author effect sizes (Pearson 0.9941; RMSE 0.0321) but calls 5 rather than 72 genes at FDR<0.1, leaving an author preprocessing/inference difference unresolved. 2026-11-16 turbo wave2: rechecked against primary sources. Europe PMC OA supplement Table1.xlsx (SHA-256 95c87dd9...) lists only the 72 DESeq2 padj<0.1 genes for OS- versus SS-housed dnFGFR males (22 up, 50 down); Table2.xlsx is sample metadata; the GEO series record lists only the raw Rsubread count matrix. No author genotype (dnFGFR versus control) gene-level result exists, so the pooled registered contrast has no same-contrast author comparator, and the threshold-selected housing table cannot meet 90% relevant coverage for any registered track. Evidence: continued-sources/GSE285006/turbo-2026-11-16-wave2/.
